scenes.heading: HOW IT *WORKS*
steps: Tests it in the running game
scenes.say: Point Claude Code, Codex or Gemini at a game you own. It reads the code, builds the mod, makes art and sound, and tests it in-game.

pros: Any game you own, even servers you host
scenes.say: The catch: art and sound use fal, which is pay per use, and it refuses online games with anti-cheat. The plugin is free and open source.
Which game would you mod first? Comment {MOD|mod} and I'll pin the link.

youtube.title: Minecraft Inside GTA V, Built by an AI Agent 🤯
youtube.description:
Minecraft inside GTA V, built by an AI coding agent. Universal Modder is a free, open-source plugin that lets Claude Code, Codex or Gemini mod almost any PC game you own: it reads the real game code, builds the mod, makes art and sound, and tests it in-game.
The catch: art, 3D and sound use fal (pay-per-use), and it refuses online games with anti-cheat.
Repo: github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder (MIT). Footage: the repo's official teaser.
